Yes, folders becoming tags is the right mapping, and preserving the original saved dates while skipping duplicates is exactly what I’d expect. Starting imported links as To read also works for me.

It’s fine not to create saved copies automatically during a large import, as long as that exception is explained in the import preview and I can create copies afterward.

The exported file should use the standard browser-bookmark HTML format so browsers and other bookmark tools can open it, and it should include the whole collection, including archived bookmarks. It should preserve at least titles, tags, and saved dates when moved elsewhere; keeping the extra app-specific details when re-imported here is useful too. With that, import and export meet my needs.
